response: Centroidal dynamics model center-of-mass motion and angular momentum driven by contact wrenches, enabling tractable planning of global motion and contact forces. instruction: Explain why centroidal dynamics are useful for legged planning and what is lost compared with full-body dynamics.
response: Centroidal dynamics model center-of-mass motion and angular momentum driven by contact wrenches, enabling tractable planning of global motion and contact forces. They omit joint-level dynamics and kinematic feasibility, so trajectories may be infeasible under joint limits, collisions, or actuator constraints; whole-body control and feasibility checks are required.

instruction: Explain why centroidal dynamics are useful for legged planning and what is lost compared with full-body dynamics.
response: Centroidal dynamics model center-of-mass motion and angular momentum driven by contact wrenches, enabling tractable planning of global motion and contact forces. They omit joint-level dynamics and kinematic feasibility, so trajectories may be infeasible under joint limits, collisions, or actuator constraints; whole-body control and feasibility checks are required.

Planner consumes goals + costmap and publishes a path. Controller consumes path + odometry and publishes velocity commands. Safety supervisor monitors diagnostics/collision and can gate commands. QoS: best-effort for high-rate sensors, reliable for transforms and command gating, deadlines/liveliness for control and safety.

Planner consumes goals + costmap and publishes a path. Controller consumes path + odometry and publishes velocity commands. Safety supervisor monitors diagnostics/collision and can gate commands. QoS: best-effort for high-rate sensors, reliable for transforms and command gating, deadlines/liveliness for control and safety.

Planner consumes goals + costmap and publishes a path. Controller consumes path + odometry and publishes velocity commands. Safety supervisor monitors diagnostics/collision and can gate commands. Planner consumes goals + costmap and publishes a path. Controller consumes path + odometry and publishes velocity commands. Safety supervisor monitors diagnostics/collision and can gate commands. QoS: best-effort for high-rate sensors, reliable for transforms and command gating, deadlines/liveliness for control and safety.

Planner consumes goals + costmap and publishes a path. Controller consumes path + odometry and publishes velocity commands. Safety supervisor monitors diagnostics/collision and can gate commands. QoS: best-effort for high-rate sensors, reliable for transforms and command gating, deadlines/liveliness for control and safety.

Approaches: (1) model-based evaluation with uncertainty and conservative bounds; (2) doubly-robust / weighted importance sampling with clipping, combined with limited safe on-robot validation and monitoring.

Approaches: (1) model-based evaluation with uncertainty and conservative bounds; (2) doubly-robust / weighted importance sampling with clipping, combined with limited safe on-robot validation and monitoring.

instruction: Explain why off-policy evaluation is difficult in robotics and give two practical approaches.
response: Robotics has distribution shift between behavior and target policies, sparse rewards, and safety constraints; naive importance sampling can have extreme variance. Approaches: (1) model-based evaluation with uncertainty and conservative bounds; (2) doubly-robust / weighted importance sampling with clipping, combined with limited safe on-robot validation and monitoring.

instruction: Explain why off-policy evaluation is difficult in robotics and give two practical approaches.
response: Robotics has distribution shift between behavior and target policies, sparse rewards, and safety constraints; naive importance sampling can have extreme variance. Approaches: (1) model-based evaluation with uncertainty and conservative bounds; (2) doubly-robust / weighted importance sampling with clipping, combined with limited safe on-robot validation and monitoring.
